# ADR-004: Implement `IntegrationInterface` for Telemetry Tagging

<!-- Generated by seed-golden-context | Last updated: 2026-05-11 -->

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Contentful's PHP SDK ecosystem uses an `IntegrationInterface` (from `contentful/core`) to let wrapper packages identify themselves to the upstream `Client`. When `$client->useIntegration($this)` is called, the client appends integration metadata to the `X-Contentful-User-Agent` HTTP header, which Contentful uses for SDK telemetry and support diagnostics.

Without this, API calls from a Laravel app using this package would be indistinguishable from calls made directly by the raw PHP SDK.

## Decision

`ContentfulServiceProvider` implements `IntegrationInterface`, returning:
- `getIntegrationName()` → `'contentful.laravel'`
- `getIntegrationPackageName()` → `'contentful/laravel'`

After constructing the `Client` singleton, the provider calls `$client->useIntegration($this)`.

## Consequences

- Contentful telemetry can distinguish requests from Laravel integrations from direct PHP SDK usage.
- The service provider now has a dual role: it is both a Laravel service provider and a `contentful/core` integration marker. This is intentional and keeps the integration declaration co-located with the bootstrap code.
- No user-facing behavior is affected.
